chapter: Instruments, own band and the Eureka
title: Reeds and clarinet versus saxophone fingering
summary: They discuss soft reeds, plastic reeds, and whether clarinetists can play saxophone, with Williams explaining clarinet high C fingering.

They say you can play a sax, you can play a clarinet, but you gotta learn both.
I don't think that's true. I think when you play clarinet, you can play sax.

You have to learn it. Your finger is different. Like that boy was playing the other night. I asked him, I said, how do you make your high C above the staff on the clarinet? He showed me the first, second, third. I tell him, well, that ain't the way I learned how to make high C. The high C, you catch that side key, you go to high register, you make that C. You see the staff, you make it first, second, and third. Fourth, and fifth, sixth, and C in the staff. The C below the staff, you make it first, second, and third.
